description: Adds a plain-English scheduling rule for one field worker (staff_id), as Add rule on their Rules tab does, e.g. "Won't work Tuesdays" or "Only mornings in Brooklyn". hardness hard (default: never scheduled against it) or soft (avoided when possible). The same wording again updates the same rule. Answers the worker's rules with their ids. Remove one with remove_staff_scheduling_rule; read every rule with read staff_scheduling_rules. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: add_staff_scheduling_rule
title: Add a scheduling rule for a field worker
